title: LaunchVehicleEntry
description: A single launch vehicle or rideshare program entry in the mission configurator catalog.

provider.description: Name of the launch provider company.

vehicle.description: Name of the launch vehicle or rideshare program.

capacity.description: Payload mass capacity to representative orbits (kg).

max_kg.description: Maximum payload mass the vehicle / slot can accommodate (kg).

to_LEO_kg.description: Capacity to a low Earth orbit reference altitude (kg). Null if not applicable.

to_SSO_kg.description: Capacity to sun-synchronous orbit reference altitude (kg). Null if not applicable.

to_GTO_kg.description: Capacity to geostationary transfer orbit (kg). Null if not applicable.

reference_altitude_km.description: Altitude at which the capacity figures are quoted (km).

min_kg.description: Minimum payload mass (rideshare minimum slot, if applicable).

base_usd.description: Base price in USD (for flat or base+per-kg models).

per_kg_usd.description: Marginal cost per kg in USD (for per-kg or base+per-kg models).

typical_total_usd.description: Typical all-in price for a reference mission in USD. Useful for rough comparison.

notes.description: Free-text notes about pricing caveats, inclusions, or discounts.

supported_orbit_types.description: List of orbit types this vehicle/program can deliver to.

inclination_flexibility.description: Degree of freedom in choosing orbital inclination.

lead_time_months.description: Expected integration lead time range (months from contract to launch).

dispensers_provided.description: Whether the provider supplies the separation system/dispenser.

launches_per_year.description: Approximate annual launch cadence for this vehicle.

next_available_window.description: Rough indication of next available launch window (e.g. 'Q1 2026', 'ongoing'). Best-effort; verify with provider.

data_sources.description: List of primary sources consulted for this entry.

notes.description: Any additional free-text notes, caveats, or context relevant to mission planning.

website_url.description: Primary website URL for the launch provider or program (https://…).
